lines=s.decode().splitlines()

after=before[:a]+new+before[a+len(old):]

assert [x for x in old if x in (9,10)]==[x for x in new if x in (9,10)]
assert after[:a]==before[:a] and after[a+len(new):]==before[a+len(old):]
p.write_bytes(after)
assert p.read_bytes().replace(new,old,1)==before

 r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 results.append({'command':' '.join(cmd),'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
 assert r.returncode==0,results[-1]
assert all(H(Path(x).read_bytes())==h for x,h in snapshot.items())
assert p.read_bytes()==after

Numeric ranks do not enter table-based _levelup_talents branch. Wording fixes ranks at summon time and makes no live-update claim.',
